title: sshd: authentication failed. - j.mehta on fin-app-01
severity_rationale: Per severity rubric: low holds because success came from account's usual source IP (10.20.1.45 IS in baseline per inventory.json#accounts/j.mehta) after fewer than 10 failures (only 1 failure), no other accounts were targeted, and nothing suspicious followed. This holds even on the high-criticality host fin-app-01. The rubric was checked in the order critical, high, low; low applies as the success came from the usual source after a single failure.
confidence_rationale: Authentication logs and asset context are complete. Network session data (tshark) cannot determine SSH login outcomes due to encryption. Some gaps exist in pre-alert login history outside the searched window. Confidence is medium.

executive_summary.text: On 2026-11-18 at 08:30 UTC, a single SSH authentication failure was recorded for account j.mehta from source IP 10.20.1.45 on the finance application server fin-app-01, followed 9 seconds later by a successful publickey login from the same IP. The source IP 10.20.1.45 is internal and j.mehta has legitimate expected publickey access to fin-app-01 per asset inventory. Severity is rated low with medium confidence; the single failure from the usual source after fewer than 10 attempts does not indicate compromise. Unknowns: the encrypted SSH session prevents determination of exact login outcome from network data alone, and full authentication history outside the 07:00-09:00 window on 2026-11-18 is unavailable. No containment action is required; standard monitoring applies.
